svg.title: Output projection: combine head outputs
svg.desc: H contains the outputs of both heads and has shape 3×8. The first and last four rows of the 8×8 Wo correspond to the two heads. Multiplication combines head components into Y of shape 3×8, which is added to residual input R.
svg.text: H (T × d) × Wo (d × d) = Y (T × d)

g.text: Combine components from the heads, then add to the residual stream.
Each output component is a weighted sum across both heads.
The same Wo is applied to every token. Input and output are both T × d.
Output Y from the Attention path
Add matching components at the same token positions.

svg.text: Colors in Wo mark rows for each input head. Values and biases are omitted.
